sarah: Quick sync — noticed higher quality variance on longctx requests when mixed-bit batches get scheduled together. Thinking scheduler + eviction patterns are the culprit. Short thread: quick wins?
nate: Which metric shows the variance? perplexity or degscore?
sarah: Using degscore + customer-facing regression-rate. Spikes correlate with interleaved FP8/INT8/4-bit slices. Hypothesis: kv-cache evictions from cross-bit packing leading to late-token loss.
anika: Can you paste a small scheduling log and kv stats so we can triage?
sarah: ```
SCHED batch_id=1234 bits=[8,4,8] seq_len=2048 kv_hit=0.62 last_token_loss_delta=0.24
SCHED batch_id=1235 bits=[8,8,8] seq_len=512 kv_hit=0.91 last_token_loss_delta=0.02
``` 
raj: Two quick angles: (1) affinity-grouping by bitwidth to avoid cross-quant eviction; (2) attach a per-slice fingerprint so we can deterministically replay and correlate deg-delta to scheduling decisions.
nate: Affinity grouping likely improves quality but reduces packing efficiency/throughput. Need to estimate qps/latency impact for hot endpoints.
sarah: Proposed heuristic: windowed scheduler that prefers same-bit grouping for hot paths (recent deg_delta > 0.05) but falls back to opportunistic packing for cold traffic. Fallback rule: if deg_delta > 0.1 for a customer bucket, pin to same-bit for N minutes.
anika: Also telemetry needs to be richer. Suggest adding fields: "slice_fp", "kv_hit", "evict_cause", "deg_delta", and a light "bits_seq" vector so we can slice/aggregate quickly.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: affinity-grouping sampling (10% traffic) starting 6288884400 — will report perf/deg metrics to #eng-ml-canaries.
raj: For replay, capture compact tuple: (model, prompt_hash, seed, slice_fp, bits_seq). Replays should be runnable locally with same kv-state. Recommend 1% shadow replays to get baseline before canary.
nate: Action items: (a) eng-ml prototype scheduler patch (sarah + nate), (b) infra/telemetry schema update (anika), (c) ops run canary and publish per-bit throughput + deg report (raj).
sarah: I'll open a PR with the scheduler patch + microbench results and a small replay dataset. @anika can you draft the telemetry schema? :thumbsup:
